```{r}
# === 2. KPIs par ville + France ===
compute_kpi <- function(df, label, level) {
  entire <- df |> filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt")
  nl <- nrow(df); nh <- length(unique(df$host_id))
  # Concentration : top 10% des h\u00f4tes g\u00e8rent X% des annonces
  hc <- sort(table(df$host_id), decreasing = TRUE)
  n10 <- ceiling(length(hc) * 0.1)
  top10_share <- round(sum(hc[1:n10]) / sum(hc) * 100, 1)
  data.frame(
    label = label, level = level,
    n_listings = nl,
    n_entire = sum(df$room_type == "Entire home/apt"),
    n_hosts = nh,
    prix_med = round(median(df$price), 0),
    prix_med_entire = round(median(entire$price), 0),
    prix_moy = round(mean(df$price), 0),
    pct_entire = round(mean(df$room_type == "Entire home/apt") * 100, 1),
    pct_multi = round(mean(df$is_multi) * 100, 1),
    pct_longterm = round(mean(df$is_longterm) * 100, 1),
    dispo_med = round(median(df$availability_365), 0),
    reviews_med = round(median(df$number_of_reviews), 0),
    rpm_med = round(median(df$reviews_per_month, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    ratio_lh = round(nl / max(nh, 1), 1),
    top10_share = top10_share,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

france_kpi <- compute_kpi(df_fr, "France (4 villes)", "country")
paris_kpi <- compute_kpi(df_fr |> filter(city == "paris"), "Paris", "city")
lyon_kpi <- compute_kpi(df_fr |> filter(city == "lyon"), "Lyon", "city")

add_density <- function(kpi, rp_total, res_sec, tour_row = NULL) {
  kpi$entire_1000rp <- round(kpi$n_entire / (rp_total / 1000), 1)
  kpi$listings_1000rps <- round(kpi$n_listings / ((rp_total + res_sec) / 1000), 1)
  if (!is.null(tour_row)) {
    kpi$htch <- tour_row$htch25
    kpi$rtuh <- tour_row$rtuh25
    kpi$ratio_airbnb_hotel <- round(kpi$n_listings / tour_row$htch25, 1)
  }
  kpi
}

# === 3. Arrondissement tables (Paris + Lyon) ===
make_arr_table <- function(df, city_name, city_kpi_row, pop_arr = NULL) {
  arr <- df |>
    group_by(neighbourhood) |>
    summarise(
      n_listings = n(),
      n_entire = sum(room_type == "Entire home/apt"),
      n_hosts = length(unique(host_id)),
      prix_med = round(median(price), 0),
      prix_med_entire = round(median(price[room_type == "Entire home/apt"]), 0),
      pct_entire = round(mean(room_type == "Entire home/apt") * 100, 1),
      pct_multi = round(mean(is_multi) * 100, 1),
      pct_longterm = round(mean(is_longterm) * 100, 1),
      dispo_med = round(median(availability_365), 0),
      .groups = "drop")

  if (!is.null(pop_arr)) {
    arr <- arr |>
      left_join(pop_arr |> select(neighbourhood, rp, res_sec), by = "neighbourhood")
  } else {
    arr$rp <- NA_real_; arr$res_sec <- NA_real_
  }

  arr <- arr |>
    mutate(
      arr_num = ifelse(neighbourhood %in% names(ARR_MAP),
                       ARR_MAP[neighbourhood], NA_character_),
      label = ifelse(!is.na(arr_num),
                     paste0(arr_num, " (", neighbourhood, ")"),
                     neighbourhood),
      level = "arr",
      ratio_lh = round(n_listings / pmax(n_hosts, 1), 1),
      entire_1000rp = ifelse(!is.na(rp) & rp >= 200,
                              round(n_entire / (rp / 1000), 1), NA_real_),
      listings_1000rps = ifelse(!is.na(rp) & !is.na(res_sec) & (rp + res_sec) > 0,
                                 round(n_listings / ((rp + res_sec) / 1000), 1), NA_real_)) |>
    arrange(desc(n_listings)) |>
    select(-neighbourhood, -arr_num, -rp, -res_sec)

  tbl_cols <- c("label", "level", "n_listings", "n_hosts", "prix_med",
                "prix_med_entire", "pct_entire", "pct_multi", "pct_longterm",
                "dispo_med", "ratio_lh", "entire_1000rp", "listings_1000rps")
  bind_rows(
    france_kpi |> select(any_of(tbl_cols)),
    city_kpi_row |> select(any_of(tbl_cols)),
    arr
  )
}

paris_territory <- make_arr_table(df_fr |> filter(city == "paris"), "Paris", paris_kpi, paris_pop_arr)

# === 4. Top hosts par ville ===
make_top_hosts <- function(df, n_top = 50) {
  total <- nrow(df)
  df |>
    group_by(host_id, host_name) |>
    summarise(
      n_listings = n(),
      prix_moy = round(mean(price), 0),
      pct_entire = round(mean(room_type == "Entire home/apt") * 100, 0),
      .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(desc(n_listings)) |>
    head(n_top) |>
    mutate(pct_offre = round(n_listings / total * 100, 2)) |>
    as.data.frame()
}

bab_commune_agg <- insee_iris |>
  filter(city == "pays-basque") |>
  group_by(arr_code) |>
  summarise(pop = sum(pop_2022, na.rm = TRUE),
            hsg = sum(log_2022, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

bab_commune_rows <- lapply(c("Biarritz", "Anglet", "Bayonne"), function(commune) {
  df_c <- df_fr |> filter(city == "pays-basque", neighbourhood_group == commune)
  pop_c <- bab_commune_agg |> filter(arr_code == commune)
  n_l <- nrow(df_c)
  nh <- length(unique(df_c$host_id))
  pop_v <- if (nrow(pop_c) > 0) pop_c$pop[1] else NA_real_
  hsg_v <- if (nrow(pop_c) > 0) pop_c$hsg[1] else NA_real_
  entire <- df_c |> filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt")
  n_ent <- nrow(entire)
  # Concentration
  hcounts <- df_c |> group_by(host_id) |> summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  l10 <- sum(hcounts$n[hcounts$n >= 10])
  cr10 <- if (n_l > 0) round(l10 / n_l * 100, 1) else NA_real_

  data.frame(
    city = tolower(commune), city_fr = commune, country_code = "FRA",
    n_listings = n_l, n_hosts = nh, pop = pop_v,
    listings_1000hab = ifelse(!is.na(pop_v) & pop_v > 0, round(n_l / (pop_v / 1000), 1), NA_real_),
    listings_1000hsg = ifelse(!is.na(hsg_v) & hsg_v > 0, round(n_l / (hsg_v / 1000), 1), NA_real_),
    entire_1000hsg = ifelse(!is.na(hsg_v) & hsg_v > 0, round(n_ent / (hsg_v / 1000), 1), NA_real_),
    prix_med = round(median(df_c$price), 0),
    prix_med_entire = ifelse(n_ent > 0, round(median(entire$price), 0), NA_real_),
    pct_entire = round(mean(df_c$room_type == "Entire home/apt") * 100, 1),
    pct_multi = round(mean(df_c$is_multi) * 100, 1),
    pct_longterm = round(mean(df_c$is_longterm) * 100, 1),
    ratio_lh = round(n_l / max(nh, 1), 1),
    cr_offre_10plus = cr10,
    dispo_med = round(median(df_c$availability_365), 0),
    revenue_est_med = NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) |> bind_rows()

europe_bench <- bind_rows(europe_bench, bab_commune_rows) |>
  arrange(desc(listings_1000hab))

# Top host per French city
top_host_lbl <- function(hosts_df) {
  if (nrow(hosts_df) > 0) {
    top <- hosts_df |> arrange(desc(n_listings)) |> head(1)
    paste0(top$host_name, " (", top$n_listings, ")")
  } else NA_character_
}
europe_bench$top_host <- NA_character_
europe_bench$top_host[europe_bench$city == "paris"] <- top_host_lbl(hosts_paris)
europe_bench$top_host[europe_bench$city == "lyon"] <- top_host_lbl(hosts_lyon)
europe_bench$top_host[europe_bench$city == "bordeaux"] <- top_host_lbl(hosts_bordeaux)
for (commune in c("Biarritz", "Anglet", "Bayonne")) {
  df_c <- df_fr |> filter(city == "pays-basque", neighbourhood_group == commune)
  if (nrow(df_c) > 0) {
    top_c <- df_c |> group_by(host_id, host_name) |>
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |> arrange(desc(n)) |> head(1)
    europe_bench$top_host[europe_bench$city == tolower(commune)] <-
      paste0(top_c$host_name, " (", top_c$n, ")")
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: header-kpi-table
{
  const fk = transpose(france_kpi_js)[0];
  const pk = transpose(paris_kpi_js)[0];
  const lk = transpose(lyon_kpi_js)[0];
  const bxk = transpose(bordeaux_kpi_js)[0];
  const babk = transpose(bab_kpi_js)[0];
  const benchData = transpose(europe_bench_data);

  const cities = [
    {name:"Paris", kpi:pk}, {name:"Lyon", kpi:lk},
    {name:"Bordeaux", kpi:bxk}, {name:"BAB", kpi:babk}
  ];
  const fN = (n) => Math.round(n).toLocaleString("fr-FR");

  // Helper ▲/▼ ranking 4 villes
  const dtl = (key) => {
    const items = cities
      .map(c => ({name: c.name, val: c.kpi[key]}))
      .filter(c => c.val != null)
      .sort((a, b) => b.val - a.val);
    if (items.length === 0) return "";
    return `<div class="kpi-ed-detail">` + items.map((c, i) => {
      const cls = i === 0 ? "u" : (i === items.length - 1 ? "d" : "");
      const marker = i === 0 ? "\u25b2" : (i === items.length - 1 ? "\u25bc" : "\u00b7");
      const v = typeof c.val === "number" && c.val % 1 !== 0 ? c.val.toFixed(1) : c.val;
      return `<span class="${cls}">${marker}</span>\u00a0${c.name} ${v}`;
    }).join(" \u00b7 ") + `</div>`;
  };

  // Row 1 grid: KPI left + Table right
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.cssText = "display:grid;grid-template-columns:30fr 70fr;gap:2px;height:100%;background:#d1d5db;";

  // LEFT — KPI éditorial 2 colonnes
  const kpiCol = document.createElement("div");
  kpiCol.style.cssText = "background:white;overflow-y:auto;";
  kpiCol.innerHTML = `
  <div class="kpi-ed">
    <div class="kpi-ed-hd" style="border-bottom-color:#0a4c6a;">
      <strong>France \u00b7 4 villes</strong>
      <span>Inside Airbnb, juin 2025</span>
    </div>
    <div class="kpi-ed-col">
      <div class="kpi-ed-title" style="border-color:#0a4c6a;">March\u00e9</div>
      <div class="kpi-ed-item">
        <span class="kpi-ed-big" style="color:#ca5800;">${fk.prix_med_entire}\u00a0\u20ac</span> /nuit \u2014 logement entier
        ${dtl("prix_med_entire")}
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-ed-item">
        <span class="kpi-ed-big" style="color:#0a4c6a;">${fk.pct_entire}\u202f%</span> logements entiers
        ${dtl("pct_entire")}
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-ed-item">
        <span class="kpi-ed-big" style="color:#0a4c6a;">${fk.entire_1000rp || "\u2014"}</span> ent.\u00a0/\u00a01\u202f000 r\u00e9s. princ.
        ${dtl("entire_1000rp")}
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-ed-item">
        Disponibilit\u00e9 m\u00e9diane <span class="kpi-ed-big" style="color:#0a4c6a;">${fk.dispo_med}</span> j/an
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-ed-item">
        <span class="kpi-ed-big" style="color:#ca5800;">${fk.pct_longterm}\u202f%</span> annonces longue dur\u00e9e (\u226530\u00a0j)
        ${dtl("pct_longterm")}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="kpi-ed-col">
      <div class="kpi-ed-title prof">Professionnalisation</div>
      <div class="kpi-ed-item">
        <span class="kpi-ed-big" style="color:#6d1a36;">${fk.pct_multi}\u202f%</span> multi-h\u00f4tes
        ${dtl("pct_multi")}
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-ed-item">
        <span class="kpi-ed-big" style="color:#6d1a36;">${fk.ratio_lh}</span> annonces / h\u00f4te
        ${dtl("ratio_lh")}
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-ed-item">
        Top 10\u202f% des h\u00f4tes = <span class="kpi-ed-big" style="color:#ca5800;">${fk.top10_share}\u202f%</span> des annonces
        ${dtl("top10_share")}
      </div>
      <div class="kpi-ed-note">Note\u00a0: 4 villes fran\u00e7aises (Paris, Lyon, Bordeaux, BAB)</div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
  wrap.appendChild(kpiCol);

  // RIGHT — Europe benchmark table with France refRow
  const COUNTRY_COL = {
    FRA:"#002395", GBR:"#C8102E", ITA:"#008C45", ESP:"#F1BF00",
    DEU:"#333333", PRT:"#006600", GRC:"#0D5EAF", NLD:"#FF6F00",
    AUT:"#EF3340", BEL:"#FDDA24", CZE:"#11457E", DNK:"#C60C30",
    HUN:"#477050", IRL:"#169B62", NOR:"#BA0C2F", SWE:"#006AA7",
    TUR:"#E30A17", CHE:"#D52B1E", LVA:"#9E3039"
  };
  const tableCol = document.createElement("div");
  tableCol.style.cssText = "background:white;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;";
  tableCol.id = "bench-europe-c";
  wrap.appendChild(tableCol);

  yield wrap;
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 80));

  // France average refRow
  const frRef = {
    n_listings: fk.n_listings, prix_med_entire: fk.prix_med_entire,
    pct_entire: fk.pct_entire, pct_multi: fk.pct_multi, pct_longterm: fk.pct_longterm,
    listings_1000hab: fk.entire_1000rp || null, listings_1000hsg: null,
    entire_1000hsg: null, ratio_lh: fk.ratio_lh, cr_offre_10plus: fk.top10_share,
    dispo_med: fk.dispo_med
  };

  const tableMod = await import(new URL("helpers/jcn-tableojs.js", document.baseURI).href);
  tableMod.buildDataTable(tableCol, benchData, {
    keys: ["n_listings","prix_med_entire",
      "pct_entire","pct_multi","pct_longterm",
      "listings_1000hab","listings_1000hsg","entire_1000hsg",
      "ratio_lh","cr_offre_10plus","dispo_med"],
    groups: [
      {label:"Stock", cols:["n_listings"]},
      {label:"Prix", cols:["prix_med_entire"]},
      {label:"Structure", cols:["pct_entire","pct_multi","pct_longterm"]},
      {label:"Pression", cols:["listings_1000hab","listings_1000hsg","entire_1000hsg"]},
      {label:"Concentration", cols:["ratio_lh","cr_offre_10plus"]},
      {label:"Activit\u00e9", cols:["dispo_med"]}
    ],
    labelCol: "city_fr",
    labelFallback: "city",
    colorCol: "country_code",
    colorMap: COUNTRY_COL,
    subCol: "top_host",
    defaultSort: "listings_1000hab",
    maxHeight: 310,
    refRow: { label: "Moy. France (4 villes)", data: frRef, bgColor: "#eef2ff" }
  });
}
```
